description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It provides a chainable logging node structure that forwards log messages to subsequent log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility in a chainable logging node, forwarding log messages to the next node if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified priority, optionally appending exception details, and forwards the log to the next node.
